objective: Test whether declared higher-timeframe context plus a measurable lower-timeframe trigger improves expectancy without changing the thesis after invalidation.
requirements: The instrument, venue, market time with timezone, session, context timeframe, and trigger timeframe are recorded.
The higher-timeframe thesis and its invalidation are declared before examining the lower-timeframe trigger.
Entry, stop, target, predefined risk, and news proximity are recorded before entry.
Direct chart observations are recorded separately from Wyckoff or smart-money interpretations.
exclusions: The original higher-timeframe thesis has invalidated.
A lower timeframe is being used to invent a replacement thesis after invalidation.
The setup depends on a label that cannot be mapped to an observable condition.
A high-impact event is inside the configured pre-trade window.

required: A market regime is declared as trend, range, expansion, compression, transition, or unclear.
The relevant range, protected swing, or liquidity reference is marked before the trigger occurs.
Accumulation, distribution, reaccumulation, or redistribution is labeled as a hypothesis with an invalidation condition.
exclusions: The range anchors or protected swing were selected after the outcome was visible.

requirements: Price trades beyond a predeclared reference extreme.
A trigger-timeframe close returns through the reference within the declared maximum reclaim bars.
The minimum penetration and reclaim thresholds are stated before entry.
The trigger agrees with the declared higher-timeframe thesis.
exclusions: The liquidity reference was not declared before price crossed it.
The reclaim occurs outside the declared maximum reclaim bars.
The lower-timeframe trigger conflicts with the higher-timeframe thesis.

requirements: Displacement exceeds the declared body-to-median or ATR threshold.
Any three-candle imbalance exceeds the declared minimum gap.
The point-of-interest range and maximum prior touches are declared before the revisit.
Entry occurs only after the declared mitigation or retest condition.
exclusions: Displacement or imbalance thresholds were selected after the outcome.
The point of interest exceeded its declared maximum prior touches.
The mitigation entry would violate the declared invalidation.
